newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill confident on IBM.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill confident on IBM.

text.p: Merrill Lynch analyst Daniel Mandresh said he had "increasing confidence" that International Business Machines Corp's product momentum in the second half would permit 1996 revenue growth of 6.7 percent and earnings of $11.75 per share for the year.

Mandresh said in a research report IBM continues to "rapidly refresh and replace its full range of hardware products, having recognized the risk of ever again falling behind the technology curve." He cited competitiveness of its new CMOS lower-cost mainframes, mid-range systems and its rapidly growing SP2 supercomputer family.
